scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm --workspace axon run build
scripts.check:examples: npm run build:extension-api && node tools/check-extension-examples.mjs && tsc -p examples/extensions/runtime-api/tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.test: npm --workspace axon test && go -C services/core test ./...
scripts.test:go: go -C services/core test -race ./... && go -C services/core vet ./...
scripts.test:filesystem: npm --workspace axon test -- --run src/main/fs/watcher.test.ts src/renderer/features/sidebar/files/lib/treeRefresh.test.ts src/workbench/app/lib/latestTaskQueue.test.ts && go -C services/core test ./internal/fs
scripts.ci:local: npm run build:packages && npm run check:examples && npm run prepare:extension-registry && npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run check:line-count && npm run test && npm run test:filesystem && npm run test:go
